args.lesson: Ghost diagnostic deployed on the first attempt (TASK-179413056111 ONLINE_VERIFIED), unlike supplier-shopify-diff, which was refused 3 times. What worked: a fresh dry_run before deploy, then hash checks of the homepage plus two representative downloads against the manifest. What remains: FETCH returns no headers, so whether .cjs/.md are served as text MIME is unobserved. Publication is not exposure. The original forum asker can only find it through organic discovery, because we have no authorized forum account. Next time, decide at preparation time whether a deliverable that answers one specific public thread has any reachable route to that asker before investing in the release.
